verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's docs show that per-campaign email reports include open and click rates, plus per-recipient and per-link click detail. E-commerce tracking measures campaign ROI, and Analytics AI explains which campaigns and automations drive revenue, which covers conversions and some automation-level attribution. The evidence does not show unsubscribe reporting in marketing campaign reports, per-step automation metrics, or time-series trending, so the story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented unsubscribe metrics per campaign, per-automation-step open/click/unsub/conversion reporting, over-time trend views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
